translations.web: Flight will perish from the swift; and the strong won’t strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;
translations.bsb: Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the mighty will not save his life.
translations.kjv: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
